buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Duration of the service contract may be extended upto 6 months beyond the initail contract duration ( S ubject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent). 2) Supplier shall ensure that the invoice is raised in the name of consignee with GSTIN of consignee only. 3) While generating invoice in Gem Portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the scre enshot of GST portal payment of GST. 4) Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting, Buyer will not take any respon sibility in this regards. GST requirements will be as per actual or as applicable rates (whichever is lower), s elect to the maximum of quoted GST%. 5) GST will be applicable as per latest order. 6) Documents required (i) Experience Certificate, (ii) Turnover Certificate and (iii) GST Certificte in the state of Tamilnadu to

be uploaded without which the offer will be summarily rejected . 7) Experience & Past performance: The CRAC details of success full contracts for the same type of service only need to be uplo aded. other services will not be considered. 8)The bidder should submit the following documents 1. Partnership Firms: The relevant Partnership Deed and Power of Attorney should be submitted. 2. Private Limited Companies: The relevant Memorandum of Association (MOA), Articles of Associ ation (AOA), Certificate of Incorporation and Power of Attorney should be submitted. SCOPE OF WORK Mason :– The work shall include maintenance, repair, and replacement of masonry works such as brickwork, plastering, flooring, pointing, patch repairs, touch-up works, and other incidental items, complete with all lead, lift, and labour, and as direct ed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The contractor shall provide, at his own cost, all tools, plant, and equipment req uired for execution of the work, including drilling machines, drill bits, cutting ma chines, and other essential tools. Scaffolding required for works up to G+3 floors shall be arranged by the contrac tor at his own cost. For works beyond G+3 floors, suitable man-lifters shall be ar ranged by the contractor at his own cost, as required. Materials required for repair/replacement works will be supplied free of cost by t he Railways, to the extent required. Power supply and water for execution of th e work will also be provided by the Railways, subject to availability. The contractor shall ensure proper handling of Railway-supplied materials and s hall clear all debris generated during execution of the work. Carpenter: – The work shall include maintenance, repair, and replacement of carpentry work s such as wooden doors, windows, cupboards, frames, shutters, rafters, reapers, fittings, fastenings, and other minor carpentry repairs, complete with all lead, lif t, and labour, and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The contractor shall provide, at his own cost, all tools, plant, and equipment req uired for execution of the work, including drilling machines, drill bits, cutting ma chines, and other essential tools. Scaffolding required for works up to G+3 floors shall be arranged by the contrac tor at his own cost. For works beyond G+3 floors, suitable man-lifters shall be ar ranged by the contractor at his own cost, as required. Materials required for repair/replacement works will be supplied free of cost by t he Railways, to the extent required. Power supply and water for execution of th e work will also be provided by the Railways, subject to availability.

The contractor shall ensure proper handling of Railway-supplied materials and s hall clear all debris generated during execution of the work. Plumber :– The work shall include maintenance, repair, and replacement of plumbing works such as overhead and underground water supply lines, sewer lines, GI/PVC pipe s, valves, sanitary fittings, water meters, and other allied plumbing works, com plete with all lead, lift, and labour, and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The contractor shall provide, at his own cost, all tools, plant, and equipment req uired for execution of the work, including drilling machines, drill bits, cutting ma chines, and other essential tools. Scaffolding required for works up to G+3 floors shall be arranged by the contrac tor at his own cost. For works beyond G+3 floors, suitable man-lifters shall be ar ranged by the contractor at his own cost, as required. Materials required for repair/replacement works will be supplied free of cost by t he Railways, to the extent required. Power supply and water for execution of th e work will also be provided by the Railways, subject to availability. The contractor shall ensure proper handling of Railway-supplied materials and s hall clear all debris generated during execution of the work. Labour :–. ● Assisting the Skilled man power like Mason, Carpenter, plumber inall wor ks. For maintaining the water supply distribution system in the railway colony at st erling garden and Pycroft’s garden. Duties include pumping water from bore wells, filter house delivery lines, and nearby GLRs (Ground Level Reservoirs) to i ndividual HLTs (House Level Tanks)/blocks as required, and operating regulating valves across a 0.50–1.00 km distribution network. The work shall be performed round the clock in 3 shifts of 8 hours each, at 4 locations, with contra ctor-supplied manpower (valve men), complete with all lead and lift, and as dire cted by the Engineer-in-Charge. The contractor's staff shall perform the following incidental duties as a valve man: ● The water level in the tanks shall be reported to all concerned pump hou ses and offices every hour, and as otherwise directed. ● All water levels shall be recorded in the level book. ● The pump house and its surroundings shall be maintained in good condit ion. ● Departmental bleaching powder or solution shall be added to the tanks d aily, or as and when required and directed. ● The valve man shall coordinate with the electrical staff. ● The valve man on duty shall leave the pump house only after the arrival of the reliever. ● Attendance and handing-over/taking-over registers shall be maintained r egularly.

● Non-supply of a valve man shall attract a penalty of Rs. 1000 per shift. Special Conditions of Contract 1. Locations: Sterling garden , Pycroft’s garden and the extent of area that will come under the jurisdiction of SSE/Works /SG/MAS section, 3 shifts. 2. Staff shall be deployed within the jurisdiction of ADEN/Bldg/MAS as per instructions 3. Working hours for the staff engaged are 9.00 am to 1.00 pm and 2.00 pm to 6.00 pm. 4. Staff attendance for general working hours (9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM, i.e., 8 working hours per day, exclusive of the 1:00 PM–2:00 PM lunch break) shall be verified and suppor ted through biometric attendance records. 5. On days when overtime/extra hours are instructed by Engineer-I n-Charge beyond the above general working hours, payment for s uch additional hours shall be made on a pro-rata basis of the appl icable per-day rate for that staff category. 6. The biometric attendance muster, duly supported by records for both general and overtime hours, shall be submitted along with t he bill/invoice for verification and processing of payment. 7. A Supervisor shall be deployed at each location/site. It shall be t he duty of the Supervisor to: (a) Obtain, in advance, details of the work to be executed on a daily from [SSE/Works] before commencement of each da y (b) Compile a day-to-day record of work carried out by the de ployed manpower at that location; and (c) Report the same to SSE/Works and ADEN on a daily basis, as instructed by the Section Engineer from time to time. 8. Consumables required for tools, such as drill bits, cutting machi ne discs, etc., which are similarly essential, shall be borne by the contractor. 9. Man-lifters required for attending to works at high-rise building s on site shall be arranged by the contractor at his own cost. 10. The labour requirement details provided are to be treated as th e minimum requirement on a general day-to-day basis. In case of emergency or additional demand, the contractor shall deploy add itional manpower as instructed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Minimum man power to be supplied is given below: ValveMen- 06 Nos Labour (Helpers) 07 Nos Mason/Carpenter/Plumber - 07 Numbers Total 20 Staffs

Penalty for Non Deployment of Labour: In the event of failure to deploy the required skilled and unskilled labout as stipu lated under the contract, a penalty of Rs.1000 per instance, along with deduction of the corrosponding wages for the non deployed labour shall be recovered from the contractor's bills. . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name FA & CAO, Southern Railway Account No. 1186402609 IFSC Code CBIN0280876 Bank Name CENTRAL BANK OF INDIA Branch address Chennai Main Branch, No.II, Second Line Beach, Chennai-600001 . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid.
